==PC==
{{needcontrols|win}}
EdisonCarter once again used his cheat-finding methods to crawl his way through the game finding cheats by choosing the closest path as well as textdumping from possible cheat keywords.

These cheats were taken from [http://www.gtasanandreas.net/news/single.php?id=1424 GTASanAndreas.net's news report], [http://www.maxbot.com/gta/sapc.htm EdisonCarter's updated cheat list], the [http://www.gtaforums.com/index.php?showtopic=194192 forum thread] where on-the-spot discoveries are made and findings announced.

These are both intelligible-word and button-press cheats. As more are discovered they will be added here and their unintelligible button-combo equivalent will be removed from the list below. All these cheats will still work in the meantime.

According to EdisonCarter's findings, the following cheats were not implemented in the PC version:
* Drive On Water
* Do Nothing
* Hookers Pay You

==PlayStation 2 and Xbox==
Any of the Xbox cheats listed below will work on the PlayStation 2 given the following mappings between Xbox and PlayStation 2 controls:
* {{xbox|LT}} → {{psx|L1}}
* {{xbox|RT}} → {{psx|R1}}
* {{xbox|white}} → {{psx|L2}}
* {{xbox|black}} → {{psx|R2}}

Currently, the most comprehensive guide is at: [http://www.gtasanandreas.net/cheats/ps2.php PS2 Cheats @ GTASanAn.com]

There is also a cheats list at [http://www.gamefaqs.com/console/ps2/code/914983.html GameFAQs.com], but this currently contains many duplicate and non-working codes.

[http://www.acheat.com/ PS Cheat Codes] San Andreas Cheats, PS2 + many other platform Game Cheats.

Riters.com hosts a [http://riters.com/GtaSaCheats/ San Andreas cheats] wiki.

Codemasters-Project.com has lists of Action Replay Max codes for both [http://www.codemasters-project.net/members/Skiller/GtaPalukArMax/GtaSacodes.htm PAL] and [http://www.codemasters-project.net/members/Skiller/GtaNtscArMax/GtaSacodes.htm NTSC]

[http://www.maxbot.com/gta/ EdisonCarter's own site] has all the cheats he discovered with his device

[http://www.gtaforums.com/index.php?showtopic=152601 All PS2 Button Codes] at GTAForums.com. All tested and fully functional.

[http://www.gtaforums.com/index.php?showtopic=188677 Action Replay codes] at GTAForums.com

[http://www.gtaforums.com/index.php?showtopic=171732 "complete" Action Replay codes] at GTAForums.com (draws from several sources so possibly more complete than the link above)

[http://www.gtaforums.com/index.php?showtopic=183941 Code Conversion Requests] at GTAForums.com. If a code is for the "other" region's Action Replay, these users will convert it.

[http://www.gta-sanandreas.com/forums/index.php?showtopic=33310 GTA-SanAndreas.com Forums] has a list of sites with cheat-device codes.

[http://www.gamesradar.com/ps2/cheats/l-G/s-a-z/p-31 GamesRadar.com] offers cheat codes and walkthroughs.
